records.title: Histological reinterpretation of paraphysis cerebri in Ambystoma mexicanum
records.authors: Rivas-Manzano P, Torres-Ramírez N, Parra-Gámez L, Ortiz-Hernández R
records.query: "dorsal sac" AND (telencephalon OR forebrain OR brain)
records.excerpt: In conclusion, we suggest that AEP and PEP are homologous to paraphysis cerebri and the dorsal sac, respectively.
records.note: Axolotl larvae: paraphysis cerebri reinterpreted as two adjacent extraventricular evaginations (anterior AEP = paraphysis; posterior PEP = dorsal sac); abstract places it in the diencephalic roof

records.title: The pineal complex: a morphological and immunohistochemical comparison between a tropical (Paracheirodon axelrodi) and a subtropical (Aphyocharax anisitsi) characid species

records.query: "dorsal sac" AND (telencephalon OR forebrain OR brain)
records.excerpt: In both species, the pineal complex consisted of three components, the pineal and parapineal organs and the dorsal sac (DS).
records.note: Teleost pineal complex = pineal + parapineal + dorsal sac; dorsal sac folding differs between species (comparative framing for the paraphysis/dorsal-sac region)

records.title: The pineal complex in the cichlid Cichlasoma dimerus: effect of different photoperiods on its cell morphology

records.note: Teleost pineal complex including dorsal sac in juveniles and adults; photoperiod effects concern pineal vesicle, not dorsal sac

records.note: Carp pineal complex incl. dorsal sac; no cellular response of dorsal sac to constant light/darkness (physiological contrast with end vesicle)

records.excerpt: Myxinoids have an ontogenetically reduced brain ventricular system. In the adult hagfish (Myxine glutinosa) the lumen of the lateral ventricle is closed, the third ventricle has a preoptic-, infundibular and subhabenular part that are not connected to each other. The choroid plexus is absent.
records.note: Hagfish: reduced ventricular system, no choroid plexus (phylogenetic baseline for roof structures)
